column1: # Ondra, the Tideglass Queen, in Tolbi.

column3: Three kind hands in one\ntown. The tide noticed.{page_break}Who wakes the Queen of\nthe Deep?{end_wait}
You look like Mia... Who\nare you?{end_wait}

Ondra. When the waking took
my kingdom, I drowned it
myself.{page_break}Mercy is cheaper than
watching. Show me yours is
real.{end_wait}
I didn't come to fight you,\nbut I won't walk away.{end_wait}
